svg.desc: DyslexiaHub: a learning website designed for dyslexic readers with calm layouts, leveled content and a practice game. Early, builder and advanced paths, game screen, FAQ, login and signup. Three learning levels, seven hand-built pages, one hundred percent hand-coded UI.
